name: Hamed Niroomand
title: Frontend Team Lead | Senior JavaScript / TypeScript Engineer
tagline: I build and lead TypeScript frontends that ship.
summary: Frontend Team Lead running a Nuxt 4 / Vue 3 team in production, with 7+ years across the JavaScript ecosystem. Led 5 engineers at Jack Westin (2022–2026), a US EdTech platform serving thousands of daily active students: owned architecture and technical strategy, designed REST API contracts with the backend lead, broke PRDs into phased delivery, and ran frontend hiring. Built a shared design-system and core-logic library (Storybook, 95%+ coverage, 4 consumer apps) and a micro-frontend integration for marketing. In parallel, held a part-time architecture and advisory role at Thales MFI (German crypto asset management), delivering a real-time multi-chain, multi-exchange portfolio tracker in Nuxt 4, NestJS, and Bun. Deep in Vue/Nuxt; early adopter of new tooling (Bun, Hono, AI SDK, MCP) and quick to pick up new stacks.
